prompt: When a hiring model makes a bad call, the company says nobody can be held responsible because the AI decided.
why: People must remain responsible for AI outcomes: accountability.
trap: The bad call may be unfair, but the issue raised is responsibility.

prompt: Any loan rejection over $50,000 must be reviewed and signed off by a human underwriter.
tells: reviewed and signed off by a human underwriter
why: Human oversight of consequential decisions is accountability.
trap: The human isn't explaining the decision; they own it.

prompt: A company sets up an AI review board that must approve each new model and can stop deployments.
why: Governance structures that own AI decisions are accountability.
trap: Testing is reliability; a body that answers for decisions is accountability.

prompt: Users can appeal an automated content-moderation decision and have a person look at it within 48 hours.
why: A route to human recourse is accountability.
trap: Content filters made the decision; the appeal path is accountability.
